mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 5% indicates tightening monetary conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 4%) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO and HOUST both show YoY growth > 5%, it signals a supply-chain bottleneck, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with joint YoY growth > 5% in INDPRO and HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery, a RSAFS increase > $100B signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 18-month rolling window during post-shock recoveries.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: high FEDFUNDS (> 4%) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns when FEDFUNDS > 4% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a PAYEMS increase > 200k signals labor market strength, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances with PAYEMS increase > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when GDPC1 and RSAFS both show YoY growth > 3%, it signals synchronized demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window with joint YoY growth > 3% in GDPC1 and RSAFS.
